facts.text: The UCA Commitment covers tuition and academic fees for incoming Arkansas first-time undergraduate students who are Pell-eligible or have an annual household income of $100,000 or less.

sources.title: UCA Commitment – UCA - University of Central Arkansas
sources.quote: The UCA Commitment provides a debt-free degree pathway by covering tuition & academic fees for incoming Arkansas first-time undergraduate students who are Pell eligible OR have an annual household income of $100,000 or less.
